name: Lubumbashi

portalsFound.observation: Ministry of Land Affairs site (HTTP 200 HTML, 105,772 bytes); per Kinshasa research it has no geodata service, only a cadastre-digitisation pilot reference.
Listed cadastre site; unreachable through the proxy.
CAMI (Cadastre Minier) is the mining-titles cadastre, not a land-parcel cadastre; page load reset/near-empty, and it would cover mining permits only.
ArcGIS Online search for Lubumbashi returned only academic land-cover/urban-sprawl maps and a historical basemap tile service, no parcel layer.
